quests.name: Find the lost cartographer
quests.objective: Learn where the map came from.

story.said: I ask the ferryman where the cartographer was last seen
lines: The ferryman spits into the brown water. "Salt flats, three days back. Took the old survey road, alone, with a lantern and more maps than sense."

story.said: I pick the lock on the survey office door
lines: The lock gives with a dry click. Inside, dust, a cold stove, and a map pinned flat under a knife.
Gained: a half-finished map of the flats

story.said: I try to read the faded notes in the margin
lines: The ink has bled into the paper; you make out a date and the word "well", nothing more.
Tried, but the dice said no: learn skill
